An ODE exhibits exponential forcing if the forcing term [MATH: f(x)] is an exponential function
[MATH: f(x) = Ke^{k x},]
where [MATH: K] is a constant.

Content:

[MATH: y_p(x) = \alpha\,e^{k x},]
where [MATH: \alpha] is a constant to be determined.
